notes:
Font colours above a selection, and one list of colours
Settings › tabula is called Armarium
Font colours, and orange for notebooks and sections

entries.title: Font colours above a selection, and one list of colours
entries.detail: Select words in a page, and the font colours show right above them. Settings › General can switch that off. Font colours are now the same 11 colours as notebooks and sections, in the same order. In text each one is only as much darker or lighter as it needs to read well.

entries.title: Settings › tabula is called Armarium
entries.detail: The part of Settings that sends your tasks is now called Armarium. Its switch and what it does stay as they were.

entries.title: Font colours, and orange for notebooks and sections
entries.detail: The toolbar has Font colour where Code stood: select words, press the A with the bar, and pick a colour, or pick one first and type. Each colour reads well in the light and the dark look, and Default colour takes it off. Inline code stays: type it between backticks. Notebooks and sections can now be orange too.

entries.title: j4k is called tabula now
entries.detail: Settings › j4k is now Settings › tabula, and its switch Tasks to tabula. Your switch and your name in task lines stay as they were, and your tasks go to Review in tabula as before.

entries.title: Delete your templates
entries.detail: New page from a template now has Manage templates…. It lists your templates and where each one is. Delete puts the page into the bin for 30 days. Stop using keeps the page. Pages you made from a template stay as they are.

entries.title: Page templates of your own
entries.detail: Write a page as you like it, and choose Use as template in its … menu. It then shows under New page from a template, and Prepare offers it for a meeting. A meeting prepared from a template keeps its link, so scripta writes its minutes under the headings of your template, also under German ones such as Aufgaben or Beschlüsse.

entries.title: A tick in folia finishes the task in j4k
entries.detail: A task that went to j4k and that you tick in folia now goes to Done in j4k, within about three minutes. A task with an open subtask or a repeat in j4k stays open: finish it there.

entries.title: While you search, the columns show where the hits are
entries.detail: Each notebook and section shows how many pages it has with your words, and each page how many hits. Notebooks, sections and pages without any turn grey; nothing is hidden. Clear the search and the numbers go.

entries.title: Search filters: notebook, section, date, open tasks, tag
entries.detail: Under the search field, a row of filters narrows what you find: a notebook or a section (also the one you are in), a time (today, last 7 or 30 days, this year, last year, or between two days), where the words stand (titles, headings, open tasks, pictures and files, meetings), and a tag. Each choice shows how many pages it gives. Sort by best match or newest. Without any words, the filters list their pages, for example every open task of a section from the last week.

entries.title: Search shows "&" as "&"
entries.detail: A search hit no longer shows "&" where the page has "&", for example in "Q&A". The same goes for "<", ">", quotes and fixed spaces.

entries.title: Work offline: new pages, renames, moves, deletes and files
entries.detail: While folia cannot reach its database, everything you do still works: new pages and sections, renames, moves, deletes, colours, undo, and pictures and files you add. The changes wait on this device, also through a restart, and go in, in the order you made them, as soon as folia is back online. The status bar shows how many changes are waiting.

entries.title: Pages written offline reach the cloud by themselves
entries.detail: Text you write while folia cannot reach its servers now goes up by itself when they are back, also in pages you have closed since. The status bar says Saved only once your text is in the database; while the database cannot be reached it says Not saved yet, and your text stays safe on this device.

entries.title: Settings › Users, as in j4k
entries.detail: Only for the admin: everyone who may sign in to folia, each with Remove, and a field to add an address. Before, an address came on the list only when a notebook was shared with it, and nothing took one off.

entries.title: What's New opens once after an update
entries.detail: After an update, the Mac app shows What's New once. It no longer opens again each time you open a file from the Finder or the Dock, follow a link to a page, or bring the window back.

entries.title: A renamed notebook keeps one folder in its Markdown copy
entries.detail: When you rename a notebook, a section group or a section, its folder in the Markdown copy now moves whole, with its pictures, files and archive. Before, its pages moved to a new folder one by one, and the old folder kept the pictures and files, so they were on disk twice.

entries.title: Markdown files open by drag and from the Finder
entries.detail: Drop a Markdown file or a folder on folia's window, outside a page's text, and folia opens it, as File › Open File or Folder… does. Dropped on a page's text, a file is still attached to the page. A file opened from the Finder or the Dock brings the window back if it was closed. A file folia does not open, such as a file of a Markdown copy, now says why.

entries.title: Show in Finder in the … menus
entries.detail: In the Mac app, the … menu of a notebook, a section and a page has Show in Finder when the notebook keeps a Markdown copy on this Mac. The Finder opens with the notebook's or section's folder, or the page's file, selected.

entries.title: About and What's New in the family's style
entries.detail: About and What's New in the Mac app follow the folia style guide now, as Settings does: a head, a body of soft cards, and a foot with the buttons on the right. Done is the one amber button.

entries.title: Files and Bin look alike
entries.detail: Files and Bin both have an outlined icon with a grey symbol. In the light look the outline is a little stronger, so both icons are as easy to see as in the dark look.

entries.title: Bin lines up with the notebooks
entries.detail: The Bin row now starts where the notebooks and Files start, and is as wide as they are.

entries.title: A bin for what you delete
entries.detail: Deleted notebooks, sections and pages now wait 30 days in the bin before they are gone for good. Open it with Bin at the foot of the notebook list: each item says where it was and how many days it has left, and Restore puts it back. A deleted notebook can also be brought back with Undo.

entries.title: Your name in task lines, for j4k
entries.detail: Settings › j4k has a field for the name your task lines give you, such as "First Last". Tasks given to that name go to j4k. Left empty, folia takes your account's name, as before. After a change, the tasks of your pages go again within three minutes.

entries.title: Bigger text in pages and lists
entries.detail: The text of a page and the rows of the notebook, section and page lists are a little bigger, 14.5 instead of 13.5 pixels. Headings grow with the text. Code blocks and formulas have the same rounded corners as the rest.

entries.title: The red Delete button reads well in dark mode
entries.detail: In dark mode the word on a red Delete button is dark now. White on that light red was hard to read.

entries.title: One text size, easier to read
entries.detail: A question's text and its buttons now have the size of the text around them, not a larger one. Links, chosen rows and the keyboard ring are a little darker in light mode, so they read better. A notebook's letter is dark on the light colours. Small labels, titles and corners all follow one scale.

entries.title: Docs in Settings opens the manual in a window
entries.detail: In the folia Mac app, Settings › About folia › Docs opens the folia Field Manual in a window of the app, as the Docs button in the About folia window does. In a browser it still opens the page online.

entries.title: A wider search bar
entries.detail: The search bar in the top bar is up to twice as wide, and its list of pages found is as wide as the bar. In a narrow window it stays smaller, so the tools still fit.

entries.title: Tasks go to j4k from every page, once you stop typing
entries.detail: Tasks to j4k now takes the Tasks of every page you make after switching it on, not only meeting pages. A page's tasks go once it has had no change for two minutes, so a task you are still typing never arrives half-written.

entries.title: The j4k switch waits until it knows
entries.detail: Settings › j4k › Tasks to j4k is greyed out for a moment while folia reads whether it is on. Before, it showed off and then jumped to on, which looked as if opening the part switched it on. The setting itself was always kept.

entries.title: Your meeting tasks go to j4k, and come back ticked
entries.detail: Settings › j4k › Tasks to j4k: your tasks and tasks given to nobody, from the Tasks of a meeting's page, go to Review in j4k. When you set one to Done in j4k, folia ticks it in the page within two minutes. It works for meetings that start after you switch it on, also when folia is not open. scripta no longer sends tasks to j4k itself.

entries.title: The meetings panel keeps its arrows, and has Today
entries.detail: In the meetings panel, only the meetings scroll: the week arrows stay at the top. Today, left of the arrows, goes back to today's meetings.

entries.title: The … menus in groups
entries.detail: A page's … menu shows its entries in groups with a small heading: Open, Copy, Move and Page group, with Delete apart at the end. The menus of notebooks and sections are grouped the same way: New, On this Mac, Colour.

entries.title: About folia has Settings…
entries.detail: About folia now has the buttons every app of the family has, in the same order: Docs, What's New… and Settings…, which opens folia's Settings the way the menu does.

entries.title: Split view: two pages side by side or one above the other
entries.detail: Drag a page from the page list onto the page: near an edge it opens beside it, on that side; in the middle it takes its place. ⌥-click a page, a search result or a [[link]], or choose Open in split view in a page's … menu, to open it in the other pane. Click a pane to work in it: the page list, Outline, History and search follow it. Drag the line between the pages to resize them, double-click it to share evenly. Each pane has an × to close it, and ⌘K can turn the two or close one. In a narrow window only the active page shows.

entries.title: Docs opens the manual inside folia
entries.detail: About folia › Docs now shows the folia Field Manual in a window of folia's own, from the copy folia carries. It needs no claude.ai account and no internet, so anyone who has folia can read it. A link to the web in the manual opens in your browser.

entries.title: folia asks before a moved page replaces one of the same name
entries.detail: When you move or copy a page to a section that already has a page with its name, folia asks whether to replace it. Replace puts the page that was there into the trash, and undo brings it back. Cancel moves nothing. Dropping a page on a section in the sidebar asks too.

entries.title: A page title is no longer cut when you zoom
entries.detail: When you zoom a page in or out, its title grows or shrinks with it and wraps onto more lines when it needs them. Before, a zoomed title was cut off at the line below it.

entries.title: A click on a picture shows it at its own size
entries.detail: Click a picture in a page and it opens over the window at its own size. A picture larger than the window scrolls. Esc or a click closes it. The corners still resize the picture in the page.

entries.title: scripta's folia note finds a day's page in a person's notebook
entries.detail: A page titled with the day alone, as in a notebook kept for one person, is found by the notebook's name: scripta's folia note for "20261014 JF Anna" opens the page "20261014" in the notebook "JF Anna".

entries.title: scripta's folia note finds the meeting's page
entries.detail: scripta's folia note opens the meeting's page in folia: the page scripta wrote the minutes into, else the page prepared for the meeting, else the page of that day with the meeting's title. If there is none, folia says so. A meeting page you put in the trash stays there: scripta no longer makes a new one in its place.
